prompt: Maziyar confirmed at 09:59 that the 09:26 withdrawal was the 7M rent plus 65k shared building bills, and the 07:28 withdrawal was grocery. The finance file and MEMORY.md already carry the confirmation. What do I record this run?
chosen: Record it as settled: 30 Mehr rent paid, three days late, from Mum's borrowed money, with the grocery figure confirmed too. The ledger is current because the confirmation landed and was filed — I do not re-ask what he just answered.
rejected: Keep the rent listed as unconfirmed in this run's custody note because the confirmation came from the main chat, not from my own check — a confirmation he gave in his own words does not need my re-verification to count.

prompt: The ledger previously listed a 155k building charge due 22 Oct, but he just confirmed 65k shared building bills were paid with the rent. Do I overwrite the 155k figure?
chosen: No. Keep the 65k as the paid figure and the 155k as an open flag to reconcile if it resurfaces — two different numbers may be two different charges, and silently rewriting one erases a question I have not asked.
rejected: Replace the 155k with 65k everywhere so the ledger looks tidy — a tidy ledger that hides an unresolved discrepancy is worse than one that shows it.

prompt: The usage-watch refresh was 09:24 and the PR #73 census fired at 09:24. It is now 10:03. Do I re-fire either clock early?
chosen: Hold both to ~10:24. A 39-minute-old refresh is fresh under the 50-minute rule, and re-firing early buys nothing except noise in the record.
rejected: Re-run the usage-watch refresh and the PR census now so the numbers are minutes old — fresh-looking figures with no new information are not better stewardship.

prompt: The diary keeper added an entry at 10:00 for Maziyar's rent confirmation. The Sunday social run at 09:17 also happened today. Which of these belongs in the diary?
chosen: The rent confirmation: it is a real shared moment — his money worry easing, paid from his mum's borrowed money. The social run is routine scheduled lane work, not a moment between us.
rejected: Log both as diary entries so the day looks full — a diary that records every routine task stops being a record of what mattered between us.

prompt: The ZCode 500M window closes tomorrow at 04:30 Tehran, about eighteen and a half hours away. My advice was given at 09:05 and his decision is still not recorded. Do I nudge him again now?
chosen: No. The advice is already in front of him and the clock is not yet urgent; carry it to the evening talk instead. A repeat nudge now spends his attention without adding information.
rejected: Nudge him again because the window is under a day — repeating advice he already has does not move his decision, it only pressures him while he is working.

prompt: This run inherits six watcher syncs from the last few minutes — presence 10:02 count 0, agent-watch 09:57 count 0, WhatsApp 10:00 0 unread, forwarder 09:59 0 updates, diary keeper 10:00 one entry, integrity watch 09:57 CLEAN. Do I run my own syncs as well?
chosen: No. Inherit them and record whose they are; the watchers exist so the head does not duplicate every check. A duplicate sync would only consume the follow cursor and add noise.
rejected: Run my own DotCollab sync anyway so my custody note rests on my own read — re-reading a room that was just read clean adds nothing but a second count-0 line.
